title: Dark Sorceress Ritual
description: A horned, purple-skinned sorceress in a red and black robe with a golden crown stands holding a glowing orb chained to her wrist. In front of her, a woman in a red dress kneels drawing a glowing purple magical circle on the stone floor of a gothic chamber filled with potion bottles, an open spellbook, and a floating eye symbol.
prompt: A regal horned female demon with purple skin and glowing eyes wearing a red royal robe and golden crown stands in a stone gothic chamber, holding a glowing magical orb connected by a red chain. A woman in a flowing red dress kneels before her drawing a glowing purple and green magical sigil on the floor. Behind them are wooden shelves filled with colorful glowing potion bottles, a lit red candle, an open spellbook, and floating mystic eyes. Dark fantasy style, detailed textures, moody lighting.
